news.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
Granite 用四种时间序列模型集成预测
news.body: 方案组合四种互补架构，提供中位数与分位数预测，无需重训或拟合集成权重。不同序列仍需比较表现，首次运行需下载成员模型。
news.title_original: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models

news.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
news.body: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI

news.title: OpenAI 推动跨服务一致的安全标准
news.body: 公告要求合作伙伴维持相应防护与协同执行，并宣布使用政策更新将于 11 月 20 日生效。不能把未来生效的要求写成今日已经实施。
news.body_original: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

news.title: Kumo Relational 用历史上下文预测关系型数据
news.body: 预训练模型直接利用数据库关系与历史样本进行推断，无需每项任务单独训练。报告结果来自指定基准，不能外推为所有企业数据上的领先表现。
news.title_original: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required

news.title: VocabX 通过词表专门化降低特定推理成本
news.body: 案例针对葡萄牙语作文评分模型调整词表，报告该部署推理成本下降。效果依赖语言、任务和工作负载，不能泛化为所有小模型都节省相同比例。
news.title_original: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications

news.title: AT&T 探索用 AI 连接企业法律知识
news.body: 合作基于 LegalEdge，计划以自然语言受理请求并关联先例、研究与历史工作。部分能力仍属规划，法律判断与决策继续由专业人员负责。
news.title_original: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
news.body_original: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

news.title: AI 辅助超声研究探索基层孕期评估
news.body: 研究利用低成本探头与非超声专业人员采集的扫查数据估计孕周，并开展前瞻性多中心验证。研究结果不等于替代完整产检或所有超声诊断。
news.title_original: Empowering frontline maternal care with AI-assisted ultrasound

news.title: TorchNeuron 教程介绍 Trainium 系统级性能分析
news.body: 教程用运行轨迹定位推理工作负载中的瓶颈，为原生 PyTorch 后端调优提供方法。实际加速幅度仍取决于模型、硬件和执行配置。
news.title_original: Profiling TorchNeuron (Part 1): System-level profiling on AWS Trainium.

news.title: Granite Speech 5.0 更新转写、翻译与说话人归属能力
news.body: 系列包括多语言语音模型与较小的 TurboCTC 模型，并报告指定评测中的速度和准确性。不同语言、音频条件与部署环境仍需单独验证。
news.title_original: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster

news.title: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 广告扩展至另外 26 国
news.body: 公告称扩展后覆盖 89 国，已有超过十万广告主投放。广告适用于 Free 与 Go；平台自报规模不代表广告主的实际收益。
news.title_original: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
news.body_original: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.

news.title: OpenAI 模型与 Codex 工作流计划接入 Google Cloud
news.body: 双方合作拟通过云平台提供原生模型与智能体工作流访问。全面可用仍有后续推出安排，不能写成所有客户已可立即使用。
news.title_original: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
news.body_original: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

news.title: Patch the Planet 协调关键漏洞修复与披露
news.body: 公告介绍 PHP 维护者牵头的修复及跨机构防护协调，并提出可重复的响应框架。发现漏洞只是起点，实际保护仍依赖修补、验证和部署。
news.title_original: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
news.body_original: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.

news.title: OpenAI 介绍 ChatGPT 广告系统架构
news.body: 专门模型协调检索、排序、相关性评估与竞价，广告选择服务与回答生成分开运行。这是平台对系统设计的介绍，不是独立隐私或效果审计。
news.title_original: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
news.body_original: Learn how OpenAI built ChatGPT’s LLM-powered ad stack to understand conversational intent, keep ads separate from answers, and deliver relevant ads at scale.

news.title: 分布式 AI 智能体分析脑细胞数据寻找研究线索
news.body: 团队用大量智能体联合分析小鼠脑细胞扰动数据和文献，整理可能的生物学关联。提出的机制与疾病研究方向仍需后续实验检验。
news.title_original: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
news.body_original: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

papers.body: arXiv:2610.29362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimator

papers.title: 紧束缚与机器学习势结合描述镁化合物
papers.body: arXiv:2606.25853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations

papers.body: arXiv:2608.29413v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polycrystal phase-field simulations are repeated for many related initial conditions, calling for integrators trained once and reused without retraining. papers.title: AI 辅助力学分析 Eshelby 稳定性
papers.body: arXiv:2610.13400v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How can human researchers use artificial intelligence (AI) to make progress on difficult mechanics problems while retaining control of physical significance, mathematical rigor, and validation? For a uniform dilatational eigenstrain in a homogeneous isotropic solid, we establish a nonlinear two-sided relation between whole-interior strain heterogeneity and a geometry-only distance from the ellipsoid family, with half-order Sobolev scaling that captures morphological length scale.
